routes.R1_LR32: E3 exact low-rank QR/core on original float32 inputs, compute float32
routes.R2_Dense32: E3 dense materialization on original float32 inputs, compute float32
routes.R3_LR64: exact same E3 float32 factor values upcast to float64 before low-rank computation
routes.R4_Dense64: exact same E3 float32 factor values upcast to float64 before dense materialization; primary reference

high_precision_tolerance_predeclared_rea: paper-side suggested starting point; fixed before any E5A computation and unchanged by outcomes
package_aggregation: same E3 block-diagonal aggregation: Frobenius squares sum across modules; spectral norm is maximum module spectral norm

dense64_feasibility.rule: if estimated live dense64 tensors exceed 70% of currently free device memory, record DENSE64_NOT_FEASIBLE_MEMORY_PRECHECK; no empirical accuracy threshold change
